title: Technical Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With 30 offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><h2>About Verve Retail Media</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The biggest challenge for advertisers in physical retail is the lack of measurable proof of effectiveness. Brands invest millions in advertising at the point of sale, but they cannot demonstrate whether those investments actually generated purchases.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Verve Retail Media (VRM) solves this problem. We market and operate digital advertising screens across several thousand grocery, drugstore and convenience store locations, connecting them with digital coupons and retargeting campaigns on connected TV (CTV) and other offsite channels.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Brands don’t book isolated advertising formats; instead, they book 360-degree campaigns that start at home and continue all the way through to an in-store purchase. This enables closed-loop measurement based on actual point-of-sale transaction data.</p> <p>VRM is the independent retail media division of publicly listed Verve Group SE. We operate like a rapidly scaling startup, with an AI-first strategy across all functions. We also have access to the infrastructure of an international ad tech company that delivers more than one trillion advertising impressions per year.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>AI needs data. While the digital world has been mapped, the vast, untapped data of human behavior and location intelligence remains the greatest challenge and the greatest opportunity. We are creating a robust data platform and sophisticated geo-targeting infrastructure that enables brands to understand shopper behavior and reach audiences effectively outside the physical store.</p> <p>In order to build this platform, we are looking for a visionary Technical Product Manager to lead the development of our cutting-edge capabilities. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of AdTech, Location Data, and AI, building the infrastructure that allows brands and retailers to engage shoppers through off-site media and precise geographic targeting.</p> <p>You will own the roadmap for our core data platform, advanced geo-targeting tools, and off-site ad integrations. <strong>Crucially, you will own the entire product lifecycle from initial discovery and scoping all the way through to commercial readiness. This end-to-end ownership requires tight collaboration with our Sales and Operations teams to ensure what we build is not only technically sound but also highly marketable and operationally scalable.</strong></p> <p>A critical focus of this role will be building products that scale globally, with a specific emphasis on spearheading our rollout and expansion into the US market. Your goal is to turn complex location and behavioral data into intelligent, monetizable media channels that drive measurable results.</p> <p>Join a collaborative team of PMs dedicated to the holistic success of our Retail Media Platform. You won't build in a silo; you'll ensure a cohesive, unified roadmap across our data infrastructure and off-site touchpoints, driving a revolution in retail technology on a global scale.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h2><strong style="font-size: 14px;">Product Strategy, Lifecycle Ownership &amp; Global Roadmap</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end product development process from discovery and ideation to commercial launch and operational readiness.</li> <li>Define and execute the product roadmap for our data platform, geo-targeting tools, and off-site media capabilities.</li> <li>Spearhead product localization and scaling efforts for international expansion, with a primary focus on the US market rollout. Ensure compliance with regional data privacy regulations (e.g., CCPA, GDPR).</li> <li>Translate business goals into technical specifications, working closely with Sales to validate market fit and with Operations to ensure seamless delivery and support post-launch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Platform &amp; Geo-Targeting Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Architect the logic and infrastructure for our advanced geo-targeting tool, enabling precise audience segmentation based on location intelligence and behavioral data.</li> <li>Oversee the development of robust data pipelines capable of processing and analyzing vast amounts of location and transaction data securely and efficiently.</li> <li>Develop features for closed-loop campaign measurement and attribution, linking off-site ad exposure to online or offline transaction data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AdTech &amp; Off-Site Integrations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead integrations with external AdTech partners, including Supply Side Platforms (SSPs), Demand Side Platforms (DSPs), and Data Management Platforms (DMPs) to facilitate seamless off-site ad delivery.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with industry standards (e.g., OpenRTB, VAST) while adapting them for specialized location-based and off-site media environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration &amp; Market Expansion</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner intimately with Sales to understand client needs and define Go-To-Market strategies for new features, ensuring commercial viability.</li> <li>Collaborate with Operations to build scalable processes for onboarding, campaign execution, and reporting.</li> <li>Act as the primary technical liaison between our engineering team and external partners/brands, especially during international rollouts, translating complex constraints into clear value propositions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Ideal Candidate</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Must-Haves:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Fluency:</strong> Strong understanding of APIs, cloud architecture, and large-scale data pipelines. You are comfortable discussing JSON payloads one minute and global business strategy the next.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Ownership:</strong> Proven track record of taking products from 0 to 1, managing the entire lifecycle from discovery to commercial rollout.</li> <li><strong>Data &amp; AdTech Expertise:</strong> Proven experience building data products, audience targeting tools, or working extensively within the AdTech ecosystem (DSPs, DMPs, SSPs).</li> <li><strong>Expansion Mindset:</strong> Experience or strong interest in scaling products internationally; an understanding of the nuances and privacy landscapes of the US market is highly desirable.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven:</strong> Ability to define success metrics (Match Rates, CPM, ROAS, Incrementality) and use data to prioritize features.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with location intelligence or geospatial data analysis.</li> <li>Background in retail media networks or off-site retail media strategies.</li> <li>Familiarity with clean room technologies or advanced attribution modeling.</li> <li><strong>Domain specific expertise is a plus but we will onboard you in case you don’t have it:</strong></li> <li>Experience as a Product Manager or Technical Product Manager, with a specific focus on AdTech, MarTech, or Data Platforms.</li> <li><strong>Retail Media Knowledge:</strong> Understanding of the Retail Media landscape, specifically how off-site media budgets are allocated and measured.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why You'll Enjoy Working Here</strong></h2> <p>This role isn’t for everyone - and that’s intentional. We’re building Verve Retail Media from the ground up, reducing legacy structures, places to hide, and “passenger seats”. This is a place for people who want to build, take ownership, and see the direct impact of their work.</p> <p>You won’t be one of many - you’ll be one of the few shaping how this company grows, decides, and wins. And every role counts - from Office Management to Chief of Staff to this role.&nbsp;</p> <p>If you’re looking for comfort, predictability, or perfectly defined lanes, this probably isn’t your environment. If you’re looking for steep growth, real responsibility, and the chance to work with people who raise your bar - you’ll feel at home here.</p> <p>What you can expect:</p> <ul> <li>Real ownership from day one - take decisions, not just tasks</li> <li>A steep learning curve - accelerated growth through real responsibility, not theory</li> <li>High-performing peers - work with ambitious, driven people who challenge and support you</li> <li>Direct impact - your work will shape products, processes, and outcomes in real time</li> <li>Cutting-edge tools - including AI-powered workflows that multiply your output</li> <li>Continuous development - training budget, internal learning formats, and language courses</li> </ul> <p>This is a place where expectations are high - and so is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and build something meaningful.</p> <p>Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.&nbsp;<br><br>If you are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, <a href="https://verve.com/california-applicant-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">click here</a> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.<br></span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">If you are located in the EU or UK visit our&nbsp;</span><a style="font-size: 8pt;" href="https://verve.com/applicant-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a><span style="font-size: 8pt;"> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Technical Depth – expertise in offensive security and managed security operations. Collaboration – works effectively with internal teams and external partners. Business Acumen – aligns technical solutions with partner and customer business goals. Proactive Mindset – anticipates partner needs and drives adoption without requiring direction. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.   • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

You will make Proxima's plasma simulation stack trustworthy by confronting it with reality. Every prediction we make for Alpha – Proxima's Q>1 experimental stellarator – and for Stellaris, our commercial power plant, rests on models whose credibility has to be earned against real measurements from an operating device.

W7-X is where we earn it. Modeling sits on Alpha's operational critical path and cannot be backfilled after first plasma – this role is how we get ahead of it.

You will be the person in the group who lives at the intersection of modeling and experiment: fluent enough in the physics to know what a model should predict, and close enough to the diagnostics to know what the data can actually support.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Validate Proxima's predictive plasma models against W7-X experimental data – neoclassical and turbulent transport, 3D equilibrium, ECRH deposition, pellet fueling and drift, bootstrap current and iota evolution – and record each comparison as a reproducible validation report with quantitative agreement metrics, stated limitations, and a pinned regression test

  • Reconstruct the plasma state from real diagnostic measurements using our time-dependent Bayesian state-estimation workflow (Thomson scattering, interferometry, CXRS, ECE, XICS, bolometry, magnetics), with calibrated uncertainties, and benchmark it against established analyses such as Minerva/IDA reconstructions and ASTRA power-balance results

  • Work with raw and pre-processed diagnostic data, not just analyzed profiles – instrument geometry, sightlines, calibrations and the caveats that come with them – and own the forward models, noise models and profile fits that feed transport analysis

  • Validate against databases of discharges rather than single shots, across W7-X magnetic configurations and operating regimes, so the output is a map of model applicability and parameter trends rather than one-off discrepancy reports

  • Feed validation back into design – convert diagnostic placement and observability studies on W7-X into requirements for Alpha's diagnostic set, and into realistic uncertainty models for the synthetic measurements we use to design against

  • Extend the modeling stack itself: mappers from experimental archives into IMAS, synthetic diagnostics, and analysis workflows, so that interpreting a shot end-to-end – raw data to reconstructed plasma state to physics quantities – runs in minutes and is reproducible by anyone in the group

  • As Alpha approaches operation, help stand up the between-shot analysis loop that will run on day one

WHO YOU ARE

  • PhD in plasma physics, fusion science, or a closely related discipline

  • Hands-on experience with experimental data from a magnetic confinement device – you have dealt with diagnostics, calibrations, systematic errors, and all the ways real data is messier than simulation output

  • Experience reconstructing the plasma state from measurements: profile fitting, integrated data analysis, equilibrium reconstruction, or power and particle balance analysis

  • Strong grounding in transport, equilibrium, and heating physics – enough to tell a code bug from a physics discovery

  • Rigorous about uncertainty; you treat a validation claim without error bars on both sides as incomplete

  • Comfortable writing and maintaining scientific software – version control, testing, and reproducibility are habits, not overhead

  • Can communicate effectively with physicists, diagnosticians, engineers, and experimentalists, and work productively inside an external collaboration

  • Self-directed; able to identify what needs to be done and execute

  • Willing to travel regularly to Greifswald, and later to the Alpha site

NICE TO HAVE

  • W7-X experience - operations, diagnostics, or data analysis, and familiarity with the W7-X data archive and Minerva

  • Stellarator physics background

  • Bayesian inference, uncertainty quantification, or machine learning applied to experimental data

  • Experience with integrated modeling and transport codes (FUSE, OMFIT, ASTRA, TRANSP, FUSE, JINTRAC, or similar) and with neoclassical (SFINCS, DKES, NEO) or gyrokinetic (GENE, CGYRO, GX, or similar) codes

  • Julia and Python programming – our integrated modeling framework is written in Julia

  • Familiarity with the IMAS data model

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

  • A track record of published validation studies or successful experimental proposals

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own and help build a scalable renewal motion for our Scaled Customer Success segment: protecting revenue and ensuring contracts reach a signed outcome ahead of expiry.

As our first dedicated Renewals Specialist, you’ll manage the end-to-end commercial renewal process for a high-volume portfolio of Enterprise customers, typically €20k–50k ARR, with around 60 renewals per quarter. You’ll work closely with our Scaled CSMs while helping us build the processes, operating rhythms, and automation that will allow renewals to scale as n8n grows. You'll usually work with billing/procurement contacts and the n8n champion on the account (often a technical user or engineer).

What you'll do

  • Own renewals end-to-end. Prepare and send renewal quotes, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, manage procurement and contractual back-and-forth, create order forms, coordinate signatures, and ensure completed contracts are accurately processed in our CRM and billing systems.

  • Manage a high-volume renewal pipeline. Keep around 60 renewals per quarter progressing with clear next steps, accurate renewal dates, and enough lead time to avoid preventable last-minute slippage.

  • Partner with CSMs on renewal risk. Work closely with Scaled CSMs to understand customer health, identify potential churn or commercial risk early, and determine the right path to renewal.

  • Keep the forecast accurate. Maintain reliable renewal forecasts, close-plan notes, and CRM hygiene so we have a clear view of upcoming renewals and revenue retention.

  • Build a more scalable renewal motion. Identify where processes break down or create unnecessary manual work, and improve the workflows, templates, operating rhythms, and automation behind them.

  • Navigate the business independently. Partner with Finance, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success to resolve commercial or contractual blockers and keep renewals moving.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🔄 B2B SaaS renewals experience: You’ve owned commercial renewals, account management, or a commercially focused Customer Success portfolio in B2B SaaS, including negotiating contracts and renewals with business customers.

  • 📚 High-volume portfolio management: You’ve managed a sizeable book of customers and are comfortable keeping dozens of commercial conversations moving simultaneously. Experience with smaller Enterprise accounts and roughly €20k–50k ARR contracts is particularly relevant.

  • 🤝 Commercial & contractual confidence: You’re comfortable negotiating pricing and terms and navigating the practical mechanics of SaaS renewals — quotes, order forms, procurement, legal review, approvals, and signatures.

  • 📈 Operational rigor: You manage your renewal pipeline with discipline. Forecasts, dates, next steps, and CRM data stay accurate, and you take ownership of getting contracts closed on time.

  • 🚀 High-growth startup experience: You’ve worked in a fast-growing environment where processes change quickly, ownership is high, and the answer isn't always already documented.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You don't just execute a process — you notice where it isn't working and help improve it. You’re comfortable creating structure while doing the work at the same time.

  • 🤖 Automation mindset: You’re interested in using automation and AI to eliminate repetitive work and make high-volume processes more scalable.

Nice-to-haves

  • ⚡ Scaled Customer Success experience: You’ve worked in a high-volume or scaled CS/renewals model before.

  • 🏢 Exposure to a mature renewals function: You’ve seen what strong renewal processes look like at a larger SaaS company and can bring some of those learnings into an earlier-stage environment.

  • 🛠️ Relevant tooling: Experience with CRM, CS, or renewals tooling such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar.

  • 🤖 n8n experience: You’ve used n8n or another workflow automation platform and are excited about what automation can do.

Why join us?

At n8n, you won’t be stepping into a fully established renewal function - you’ll help create it.

Our Scaled Customer Success team is still relatively new, while the number of customers and renewals we manage is growing quickly. As our first dedicated renewals hire for this segment, you’ll have real influence over how we structure the renewal process, what we automate, and how we manage retention efficiently as we scale.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on commercial ownership with building something from the ground up. You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Legal, and you'll be able to see the direct impact of your work on our customers and revenue.

We’re particularly interested in using AI and automation to scale the function without simply adding more headcount, so if you enjoy finding smarter ways to eliminate repetitive work and improve processes, you’ll have plenty of room to experiment.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now and help us build the renewal motion that will support n8n’s next stage of growth.

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We’re now looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to make sure our GTM team scales just as fast - and just as effectively.

🎯 Your main goal will be to enable GTM teams to close more deals faster by providing the knowledge, resources, and training they need to succeed at every stage of the buyer journey.

You’ll be helping us build on early-stage existing foundations (onboarding, certifications, tooling) and take it to the next level as we scale. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a direct line to revenue outcomes.

 

🚀 Build onboarding that shortens ramp time and boosts impact

  • Design and deliver world-class onboarding for new GTM team members across Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering.

  • Track and continuously improve ramp time through tailored strategies and performance feedback loops.

  • Collaborate with leadership to define what “great” looks like across roles and build onboarding paths accordingly.

📚 Create scalable enablement programs that drive revenue

  • Translate product updates, GTM strategies, and technical concepts into clear, actionable content.

  • Identify knowledge gaps and build role-specific enablement initiatives to address them.

  • Design certifications and training frameworks (e.g. demo, discovery, technical proficiency) to ensure consistency and quality across the field.

🎤 Run high-impact enablement events and internal comms

  • Support the planning and execution of team-wide enablement moments like SKOs, regional kickoffs, and quarterly readiness sessions, partnering closely with sales and revenue leadership on strategy and messaging.

  • Act as the voice of enablement for GTM teams, making sure they have the right information at the right time, through the right channels.

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and RevOps to sync launches, messaging, and process changes.

📊 Measure what matters and make enablement a growth driver

  • Define and track KPIs to demonstrate enablement’s impact on sales productivity, pipeline velocity, and deal size.

  • Build a competency scorecard with GTM managers to support coaching and performance management.

  • Use insights from sales calls, Gong data, and product usage to continuously refine your programs.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🧠 Sales enablement experience in PLG SaaS: You have 4+ years of enablement experience at fast-growing SaaS companies, ideally building enablement from scratch in a PLG environment.

  • 💼 Deal complexity experience: You've enabled teams selling mid-market to enterprise deals (6 to low-7 figures).

  • 🧑‍💻 Technical buyer fluency: You understand how to sell to technical personas (CTOs, engineering managers) and can translate that into training that resonates with a technical AE audience.

  • 📚 Learning program design: You’ve built high-quality, scalable training programs tailored to different GTM roles and seniority levels.

  • 🗣️ Strong communicator: You excel at turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, and actionable content for sales teams.

  • 🧘 Organized and proactive: You’re structured, self-directed, and take ownership without needing hand-holding.

  • 🤝 Customer-first mindset: You focus on enabling the team to better articulate our value and deliver better buyer experiences.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🤖 Passion for automation and AI: You’re excited by the space we’re building in — and it shows.

  • 🔧 Familiarity with n8n: You’ve used the product (or are eager to start).

Why join us?

This is your chance to build something from the ground up: a high-leverage enablement function in a high-growth company, with a direct line to revenue impact. You'll be joining a supportive, fast-moving, and collaborative team where enablement is viewed as a strategic lever — not a support function. Help us scale our product, our message, and our people.

Apply now — and help us turn our GTM teams into a world-class sales engine.

Eine proaktive, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und Interesse an der Mission von ChurchDesk und der Rolle der Kirche in einer sich wandelnden Gesellschaft. Was wir Dir bieten Eine Rolle in einem wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen , in der du echte Verantwortung übernimmst, deine Arbeit aktiv mitgestaltest und dabei viel dazulernst.   • Du gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden im DACH-Raum durch gezielte Outbound-Aktivitäten, die Bearbeitung von Inbound-Leads und den Aufbau eines starken Netzwerks in der kirchlichen Landschaft.

  • Du führst komplexe Sales-Zyklen eigenständig – von Prospecting und Bedarfsanalyse über Präsentationen bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

  • Du verstehst die Strukturen und Herausforderungen großer kirchlicher Organisationen und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.

  • Du pflegst eine gesunde Pipeline, erstellst verlässliche Forecasts und übernimmst Verantwortung für Dein eigenes Umsatzziel.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success, Produkt und Marketing zusammen und sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe neuer Kunden.

  • Du vertrittst ChurchDesk professionell bei Kundenterminen vor Ort, auf Fachkonferenzen und gegenüber hochrangigen kirchlichen Entscheidungsträgern.


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise als Account Executive mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden im SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Du hast bereits erfolgreich Neukunden gewonnen und weißt, wie man auch in längeren, komplexen Sales-Zyklen ans Ziel kommt.

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb an stakeholder-getriebene Organisationen, idealerweise im kirchlichen, NGO- oder öffentlichen Umfeld.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungskompetenz – auch auf Führungs- und Leitungsebene.

  • Du fühlst Dich in HubSpot zu Hause und nutzt es, um Deine Pipeline strukturiert im Blick zu behalten.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des DACH-Raums.

  • Eine proaktive, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und Interesse an der Mission von ChurchDesk und der Rolle der Kirche in einer sich wandelnden Gesellschaft.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Eine Rolle in einem wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen, in der du echte Verantwortung übernimmst, deine Arbeit aktiv mitgestaltest und dabei viel dazulernst.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub – weil ausreichend Erholung wichtig ist.

  • 37 Stunden Arbeitswoche – mehr Balance, mehr Zeit für dich.

  • Eine offene und ehrliche Feedbackkultur – gemeinsam wachsen, voneinander lernen, transparent kommunizieren.

  • Ein wunderschönes, modernes Altbau-Office im Herzen Neukölln – zentral, lebendig und perfekt angebunden. 

  • Lust auf einen Tapetenwechsel? Besuche uns in Kopenhagen, Oslo oder Groningen! Wir übernehmen deine Reise- und Spesenkosten.

  • Unvergessliche Team-Erlebnisse – von Company Events bis zu gemeinsamen Reisen nach Kroatien & Prag.

Über ChurchDesk

Bei ChurchDesk sind wir der Meinung, dass die Kirche eine wichtige Rolle in der Gesellschaft spielt. Unsere Plattform wird von Tausenden von Gemeinden genutzt, um ihre Arbeit zu organisieren, die Kommunikation mit Mitgliedern zu verbessern, mehr Menschen zu erreichen und neue Möglichkeiten der Mittelbeschaffung zu erschließen.
Unsere Kunden sind Teil einer der größten und ältesten Institutionen der Welt: der Kirche. Sie befindet sich in einem erheblichen Wandel, um sich auf die Zukunft vorzubereiten – und wir sind hier, um diese Transformation zu unterstützen. Für Kirchen in ganz Europa ist es entscheidend, effizienter zu arbeiten und mit ihren Mitgliedern und Gemeinden in Verbindung zu bleiben.

ChurchDesk gibt es seit mehr als 15 Jahren – von einem Startup zu einem internationalen Unternehmen, das Kunden in ganz Europa bedient. Und wir fangen gerade erst an!

Wir leben unsere Werte aktiv in unserer täglichen Arbeit:

#challenge: Wir fordern uns selbst – und unsere Kunden – kontinuierlich heraus, uns zu verbessern. Wir arbeiten wie ein professionelles Sportteam: mit Ehrgeiz, Disziplin und starkem Teamgeist.

#dogoodbusiness: Gutes Geschäft zu machen ist ein Marathon, kein Sprint. Es erfordert Ausdauer, Qualität und Integrität – jeden einzelnen Tag.

#jointheride: Die Reise ist genauso wichtig wie das Ziel. Seien Sie ein Teil davon, feiern Sie Erfolge – und haben Sie Spaß! Wir schätzen es, zusammen zu sein, besonders im Büro.

raw.title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

What we offer

  • Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Who will I report to? Our VP Engineering. The role is sponsored by our CPTO: the frontend platform is one of the CPTO's top priorities, you agree the target architecture and migration roadmap together, and the CPTO holds your final interview.

Which tech stack will I work with? React and TypeScript on both products. FactFinder NG runs on a Java backend, Infinity on .NET/F# (with Fable/Feliz on the frontend). Backend, F# and our search domain are things you can learn here – React expertise, Web Components, design-system architecture and AI-first practice are what you bring from day one.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Two legacy frontends on Java and .NET – isn't that painful? That's exactly the mandate: unify them, and how is your call. Incremental, not big-bang.

Can I work fully remote? No – the role is hybrid with 2–3 office days per week at one of our offices.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
raw.description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. description: Introduction Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom. Your mission The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners Your profile You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements to go-live You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English Why us? Work Environment & Organization: You enjoy working in our Munich office and value face-to-face interaction with your team. In addition, you can work from home one day a week. Introduction

Do you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting.
You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom.


Your mission

  • The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core
  • Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements
  • You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems
  • Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce
  • You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners


Your profile

  • You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements to go-live
  • You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes
  • For you, Odoo is not just a configuration tool: ORM, inheritance, Views, and QWeb, access rights, and cron jobs are all part of your skill set—ideally complemented by Odoo E-Commerce
  • You confidently analyze existing software, refactor it strategically, and further develop it with a focus on quality, maintainability, and stability
  • Experience with Odoo upgrades, data migrations, multi-company setups, or integrating payment service providers is a definite plus
  • You work in a structured and independent manner, document clearly, and communicate on an equal footing in German and English


Why us?

raw.description:
**METAKI
**Dresden, Germany (TU Dresden) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AI for Engineering

**About Metaki
**Metaki is building a 'Large Engineering Model' (LEM): a graph-neural-network surrogate trained on large-scale finite element simulation (FEA) data that predicts, near-instantly, how complex 3D parts respond to different materials, loads and boundary conditions — replacing slow FEA runs. The initial focus is solid and structural mechanics, with the long-term ambition of a general foundation model for engineering physics.

**The opportunity
**Founded by Samir El Masri (Founder, ongoing PhD in FEM, 3 years of industry experience in FEM & AI/ML for engineering), Metaki already has a working FEM → data → NN pipeline, is building out a large 3D training dataset, and is running training alongside early industry discussions. What's missing is a technical co-founder to help scale the modeling and engineering work while Samir also drives funding applications and industrial pilot partnerships.

Tasks

**What you will own
**

**Model & platform development
**- Co-own the neural-network surrogate modeling pipeline (FEM data → GNN training → fast inference), extending it from solid/structural mechanics towards a general engineering-physics foundation model.
- Scale the large 3D simulation dataset and physics-informed training infrastructure currently in development.

**Technical leadership
**- Take technical/CTO ownership alongside Samir El Masri (Founder), covering architecture, ML engineering and data pipeline decisions.
- Help turn early industry discussions into validated industrial pilots by making the model production-ready.

**Fundraising support
**- Support funding applications and strategic introductions with a credible technical narrative and roadmap.

Requirements

**What you bring
**

**Core experience
**- Strong machine learning background, ideally with graph neural networks, surrogate modeling, or physics-informed ML.
- Comfort working with finite element simulation data and engineering/physics domain concepts (solid or structural mechanics a plus).

**Especially valuable
**- Software/ML engineering experience taking a research pipeline to a scalable, production-ready product.
- Interest in building toward a general foundation model for engineering physics.
- Experience with industrial pilot partnerships or applied research collaborations.

Benefits

**Why join Metaki
**- A working FEM → data → NN pipeline already built, not just an idea — real technical traction to build on.
- Early industry discussions already underway, with funding applications and pilot partnerships actively being pursued.
- Ground-floor technical co-founder equity in a company aiming to become a foundational-model platform for engineering physics.

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech?&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong>: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar</li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p>Europe is Quince's next growth engine. We have launched in the UK, with further European markets on the roadmap, and organic discovery is one of the biggest untapped levers we have.</p> <p>We are looking for an SEO Manager, UK &amp; EU. You will own the organic strategy for our European markets across both traditional search and generative engines (AEO), building our European playbook.</p> <p>This is a cross-market, hands-on role with an unusual amount of ownership. Technical SEO standards and platform-level architecture come primarily from our global SEO team in the US; you are the person who translates those foundations into a European strategy, identifies where Europe needs something different, and makes the case for it. You will work day to day with storefront, copywriting, merchandising, growth marketing, engineering and data — and you will be the main driver for organic growth in the region.</p> <p>If you want to build an organic program from the ground up in markets where the brand is still being established, this is that job.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the UK/EU SEO &amp; AEO strategy.</strong> Build and maintain a market-level roadmap that reflects the real competitive dynamics of each country rather than a copy of the US plan. Decide where we play, which categories we go after first, and what winning looks like in each market.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with the global SEO team.</strong> Adopt and apply global technical standards, feed European requirements into the global roadmap, and flag where a one-size-fits-all approach breaks down in-market.</li> <li><strong>Drive answer engine optimisation across Europe.</strong> Build Quince's presence in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and the surfaces that follow. Own structured data coverage, entity and brand consistency, citation-worthy content, and the measurement approach that tells us whether any of it is working.</li> <li><strong>Make localisation a search advantage, not an afterthought.</strong> Work with copywriting and localisation to ensure category, PDP and editorial content targets genuine local search demand — not translated US keywords. Build the keyword and demand research foundation for each market and turn it into briefs writers can act on.</li> <li><strong>Own international search architecture in-market.</strong> Hreflang and market targeting, URL and domain structure, canonical logic, indexation of localised catalogues, and the crawl health of each European storefront — specced and QA'd with global SEO and engineering, with you accountable for the outcome.</li> <li><strong>Shape the storefront with merchandising and site merch.</strong> Influence category taxonomy, navigation, on-site search and PLP structure so that pages serve organic discovery as well as conversion. Partner on how content is modelled in our CMS and how listing pages are built and ranked.</li> <li><strong>Work in lockstep with growth marketing.</strong> Understand where organic and paid overlap, where they cannibalise, and where organic can take load off paid spend. Bring an incrementality mindset to the way we report and invest.</li> <li><strong>Own SEO/AEO readiness for new market launches.</strong> Define the checklist, run it, and make sure every new European storefront goes live search-ready rather than being retrofitted six months later.</li> <li><strong>Measure, report and build the case for investment.</strong> Own market-level organic reporting and the quarterly narrative for European and global leadership.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Required experience</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in SEO, ideally in ecommerce, retail or consumer brands, with meaningful ownership of organic performance.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience running SEO across more than one country or language.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of technical SEO: crawl and indexation, site architecture, structured data, page performance.&nbsp;</li> <li>Content-led SEO experience: keyword and demand research, content strategy, briefing writers, and building category and editorial content that ranks and converts.</li> <li>Practical exposure to AEO — structured data, entity management, and a real point of view on how Quince should show up in AI-driven discovery.</li> <li>Comfortable in the data: Google Search Console, GA4, and the standard SEO toolset (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar).</li> <li>Excellent communicator in English, and effective working asynchronously with a headquarters team in another time zone.</li> <li>A bias for shipping. You are happy operating without a large team, deciding what matters most this quarter, and doing the work yourself.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Preferred</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Working proficiency in English and, preferably, a second language (e.g. German, French, or Spanish).</li> <li>Experience launching ecommerce storefronts in new countries.</li> <li>Familiarity with headless CMS and search stacks (e.g. Contentful, Algolia) and translation management platforms (e.g. Smartling).</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted tooling to produce or optimise content, metadata and structured data at scale.</li> <li>Apparel, home or lifestyle retail experience in the European market.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who you are</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable process that scales to five markets than win one category by hand.</li> <li>You are genuinely curious about how discovery is changing, and you are already testing how AI-driven search behaves in your own markets.</li> <li>You are persuasive without authority. Much of your impact comes from convincing merchandisers, writers, engineers and a global team to prioritise your work.</li> <li>You are commercially minded. You connect organic performance to revenue, not just to rankings.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with being early. Europe is not a finished operation, and you will help decide what it becomes.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing <a href="https://forms.gle/DpJ11jHa1WbqfUWB9">this accommodation form</a>. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4428">Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for <strong>10,000+ businesses worldwide</strong>, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Headquartered in Berlin.</p> <p>We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.</p> <p>In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Location &amp; work mode</span></h4> <p>Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. EU work permit required.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">What you'll do</span></h4> <ul> <li>Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure</li> <li>Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow</li> <li>Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself</li> <li>Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves</li> <li>Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap</li> <li>Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it</li> <li>Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships</li> <li>Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus</li> <li>Shameless customer obsession</li> <li>Extreme clarity in writing and thinking</li> <li>Speed without sloppiness</li> <li>Low ego and a builder's instinct</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">What we offer</span></h4> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and meaningful VSOP at a profitable, growing company</li> <li>Modern Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg</li> <li>Direct work with the founders and a real seat at the product table</li> <li>A team that ships fast and doesn't drown in process</li> <li>26 days of paid vacation, plus 2 extra days off for Christmas and New Year's Eve</li> <li>Annual personal development budget for conferences, courses, books, or coaching</li> <li>Regular team events, off-sites, and the kind of culture that makes you want to be in the office</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">See how we ship</span></h4> <p>Every year we publish a Rewind: a public record of everything we built and shipped. Probably the easiest way to see what we've been up to.</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.superchat.de/superchat-rewind-2025">Superchat Rewind 2025</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.superchat.de/superchat-rewind-2024">Superchat Rewind 2024</a></li> </ul> <p><strong>We firmly believe that diversity makes companies better. We welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to send us your application!</strong></p> <p><strong>By submitting your application, you agree to our <a href="https://www.notion.so/native/f601741cb4f24d418411aa0ff86c3787?pvs=21&amp;deepLinkOpenNewTab=true">privacy policy</a>.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>We look forward to your application! 🙂</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uicf3C7.jpg" alt="" width="800" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
