title: Prozessmanager:in (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. metrify ist die Smart-Metering-Unit von Enpal und die digitale Infrastruktur für ein intelligentes Energie-Ökosystem. Mit zehntausenden installierten iMSys und skalierbaren Prozessen machen wir Energie messbar, steuerbar und wirtschaftlich nutzbar – und schaffen gemeinsam mit Partnern die Basis für neue Geschäftsmodelle der Energiewende. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust operative Vorgänge rund um den Smart‑Meter‑Wechsel und hältst alle dafür notwendigen Informationen in unseren Systemen aktuell. Du arbeitest täglich in mehreren Systemen gleichzeitig, erkennst Abweichungen und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Auftrag im System sauber durchläuft und korrekt abgeschlossen wird. Du kommunizierst klar und professionell mit Netzbetreibern, Marktpartnern & internen Teams (E-Mail, Telefon, Portale, Tickets). Du denkst in Regeln und Mustern: du erkennst Prozessfehler, findest Ursachen und schlägst Verbesserungen vor.Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Tasks den Überblick und kannst diese priorisieren. Du stellst sicher, dass regulatorische Anforderungen & interne Standards eingehalten werden. Dein Profil Du hast eine hohe Affinität zu digitalen Systemen und arbeitest gerne mit mehreren Tools und Oberflächen parallel. Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und präzise – du magst es, wenn Daten sauber sind und Prozesse logisch laufen. Du erkennst Muster, arbeitest gerne mit Regeln/Checklisten und fühlst dich in systematischen Abläufen wohl. Du priorisierst gut, kannst viele parallele Vorgänge ruhig sortieren und verlierst nicht den Überblick.Du bist selbstorganisiert, lösungsorientiert und arbeistest selbstständig. Du kommunizierst klar – intern wie extern – und fragst früh nach, wenn Informationen fehlen.Du hast Lust, dich in ein komplexes, spannendes Arbeitsfeld (Energiewirtschaft / Marktprozesse) einzuarbeiten. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heiligabend und Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Role Overview:</strong></p> <p>The Senior People Technology Analyst is responsible for leading the design, configuration, and continuous evolution of Workday Human Capital Management (HCM) capabilities as part of SIE’s global People Technology platform.</p> <p>This role serves as a senior technical leader and functional expert within People Technology Services (PTS), with senior ownership within the Workday Core HCM domain. This role is responsible for system configuration, business process optimization, security administration, custom reporting, and end-user support. Works closely with HR leadership, Payroll, IT, and cross-functional teams to ensure data integrity, streamline employee lifecycle workflows, and maximize the value of the organization’s Workday platform.</p> <p>The role is accountable for ensuring that core HCM solutions are scalable, precise, and aligned with global business requirements, while also contributing to broader Workday platform design and delivery. The role works closely with Human Resources stakeholders to translate policy, regulatory requirements, and business processes into scalable, system-driven solutions.</p> <p>Operating within a globally consistent Agile delivery model, this role balances deep domain expertise with cross-platform contribution. The role partners with Product, Integration, Data, and Architecture stakeholders to deliver cohesive, end-to-end solutions and to establish sustainable configuration patterns across the platform.</p> <p>This role is suited for individuals who combine deep expertise in Workday HCM with strong systems thinking, technical leadership, and the ability to influence design decisions across a global platform.</p> <p><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Domain Ownership &amp; Platform Leadership (Core HCM)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a senior functional and technical lead for the Workday Core HCM domain, leading complex configuration design, system enhancements, and ongoing platform evolution.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of complex Core HCM solutions in partnership with Human Resources stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business requirements, global standards, regulatory requirements, and operational needs:</li> <ul> <li>Configure and maintain core Workday HCM components, including supervisory organizations, job families, positions, location hierarchies, and worker profiles. &nbsp;</li> <li>Design, build, and optimize Workday Business Processes (BPs) (e.g., Hire, Transfer, Promote, Terminate, Job Change) using condition rules and validation logic.</li> <li>Manage domain and business process security policies, ensuring appropriate role-based access control and data privacy compliance.</li> </ul> <li>Define and enforce configuration design patterns that ensure scalability, reusability, and maintainability</li> <li>Serve as a key technical authority for Core HCM design decisions, guiding trade-offs between business requirements, system capabilities, and long-term platform sustainability.</li> <li>Ensure alignment of HCM and core configurations with global policies, regulatory requirements, and downstream dependencies (e.g., payroll)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Solution Design &amp; Delivery Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engage with Human Resources stakeholders to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, and guide toward scalable, platform-aligned solutions</li> <li>Lead end-to-end delivery of complex Workday HCM related initiatives, including design, build, testing, and deployment readiness</li> <li>Translate complex business rules, policies, and regulatory requirements into structured, scalable system configurations</li> <li>Provide technical leadership across workstreams, ensuring consistency and quality of solutions delivered by the team</li> <li>Support and guide analysts in solution design and configuration, ensuring alignment with platform standards</li> </ul> <p><strong>Platform Engineering &amp; Cross-Domain Contribution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to broader Workday platform design and configuration across additional domains (e.g., Absence &amp; Leave, Compensation, Talent, Performance)</li> <li>Collaborate with Integration and Data specialists to ensure end-to-end solution integrity</li> <li>Participate in platform-level design discussions, influencing architecture, standards, and ways of working</li> <li>Ensure solutions integrate effectively with upstream and downstream systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data, Reporting &amp; Downstream Integrity</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and oversee reporting solutions and calculated fields supporting core HCM and related processes</li> <li>Ensure Workday HCM core data supports HR reporting, compliance, and downstream processes (e.g., payroll and analytics)</li> <li>Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across Workday configurations and downstream consumers</li> </ul> <p><strong>Platform Reliability &amp; Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure reliability and stability of business processes through proactive issue identification and root cause resolution</li> <li>Identify systemic issues and drive structural improvements to platform design and configuration practices</li> <li>Lead initiatives to simplify, standardize, and continuously improve Core HCM configurations, business processes, and data structures.</li> <li>Contribute to evolving platform standards, governance models, and configuration frameworks</li> </ul> <p><strong>Governance, Compliance &amp; Standards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensure adherence to global PTS design standards, governance practices, and engineering principles</li> <li>Ensure core HCM configurations meet data privacy, security, and audit requirements</li> <li>Contribute to documentation standards, testing practices, and release management processes</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience with enterprise platforms, including significant hands-on experience with Workday</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing core HCM solutions, eligibility rules, calculated fields and business processes</li> <li>Proven ability to own and lead complex configuration domains, including defining design patterns and standards</li> <li>Strong understanding of core HCM related business processes across multiple regions and regulatory contexts</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate complex business rules and policies into scalable, maintainable system configurations</li> <li>Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex configuration issues, including calculation logic and system behavior</li> <li>Hands-on experience developing Workday reports and Workday Security configuration &nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience with mass data uploads using Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) tools.</li> <li>Experience working across multiple Workday domains and understanding cross-domain dependencies</li> <li>Ability to guide and mentor other analysts in solution design and delivery</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with payroll processes and downstream integrations &nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Exposure to integrations (e.g., EIB, Core Connectors) or inbound/outbound payroll feeds</li> <li>Experience contributing to platform architecture, standards, or governance frameworks</li> <li>Experience working in global, matrixed enterprise environments</li> </ul> <p><strong>Profile:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in Workday Core HCM, with the ability to lead complex solution and configuration design.</li> <li>Strong systems thinker who understands cross-domain dependencies, downstream impacts, and the broader People Technology ecosystem.</li> <li>Skilled at translating complex or ambiguous business requirements, policies, and regulations into scalable, sustainable system solutions.</li> <li>Operates as a senior technical leader who guides others, influences design decisions, and remains hands-on when needed.</li> <li>Trusted partner to Human Resources stakeholders, with strong consulting, communication, and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Demonstrates strong ownership, sound judgment, and a consistent focus on data integrity, platform reliability, and high-quality outcomes.</li> <li>Comfortable working in a global, evolving environment, with the ability to influence beyond immediate responsibilities</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our&nbsp;<a Role Purpose

The IAM Analyst is responsible for delivering and improving Identity & Access Management controls across ClearBank.

This role combines operational IAM responsibilities with ownership of processes such as access reviews, identity lifecycle management, and privileged access controls. The IAM Analyst will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to ensure access is appropriately governed, secure, and aligned with regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage joiner, mover, leaver (JML) processes to ensure accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access

  • Own and deliver periodic access reviews and certification campaigns across key systems

  • Administer identity platforms (e.g. Microsoft Entra ID) including role-based access control and group management

  • Support and maintain privileged access management processes and controls

  • Act as a point of contact for IAM-related queries and provide guidance to stakeholders

  • Investigate and resolve access-related incidents and issues

  • Ensure IAM activities are documented and audit-ready, supporting internal and external audits

  • Work with application owners to define and maintain appropriate access models

  • Identify opportunities to improve and automate IAM processes and workflows

  • Contribute to IAM projects, including tooling enhancements and onboarding of new applications

What success looks like in the role:

  • IAM processes are delivered consistently, efficiently, and in line with policy and SLAs

  • Access reviews are completed with high engagement and strong audit evidence

  • Access risks are proactively identified and mitigated

  • Stakeholders trust IAM as a knowledgeable and reliable function

  • Continuous improvements and automation opportunities are regularly delivered

Skills & Experience (must have)

  • Solid understanding of Identity & Access Management principles (RBAC, least privilege, segregation of duties)

  • Experience managing user access and identity lifecycle processes in an enterprise environment

  • Experience administering identity platforms (e.g. Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD or equivalent)

  • Strong understanding of access reviews, governance, and compliance requirements

  • Ability to analyze access requirements and implement appropriate controls

  • Experience working with ticketing systems and structured operational processes

  • Strong communication skills and ability to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to investigate and resolve issues

  • Experience with software development, programming, or Infrastructure as Code (IaC) technologies, with Terraform preferred

  • Scripting or automation experience (e.g. PowerShell, Logic Apps, Power Automate)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with IAM tooling (e.g. SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, CyberArk)

  • Knowledge of privileged access management (PAM) solutions and controls

  • Experience in financial services or regulated environments

  • Exposure to audit processes and regulatory frameworks (e.g. ISO, SOX, FCA expectations)

Internal Role Level: L2

You will lead and develop Biddable activation teams, cultivate strong client and supplier relationships, and define advanced Biddable strategies that align with business objectives and drive growth. Your expertise will provide rigorous and innovative recommendations across both Paid Search and Paid Social, ensuring continuous optimization and adherence to best practices, and strategically weaving Biddable into overall cross-channel campaign strategies within the WPP Open ecosystem.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Line Management:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and development to direct Biddable activation teams (including Account Managers and Account Executives), fostering excellence and professional growth. Support capacity planning and resource management, leading recruitment for your immediate team and assisting with wider team recruitment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Biddable Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and lead advanced Biddable strategies for client portfolios, ensuring clear alignment with business objectives, KPIs, and industry context across both Paid Search and Paid Social.</li> <li>Provide strategic insight for client product areas within Biddable media, and proactively spot trends, product releases, and opportunities to enhance activity.</li> <li>Oversee the development and creation of Biddable best practices, with ultimate accountability for adherence to controls and effective oversight of designated campaigns.</li> <li>Develop thought leadership pieces and case studies to galvanize the role of Biddable within the wider media community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client &amp; Partner Relationship Management:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop strong relationships with key clients and suppliers, leading team communications with these stakeholders and providing useful insight independently.</li> <li>Lead efforts to gather and disseminate client intelligence to understand and meet their business needs, navigating critical business changes and complex issues.</li> <li>Manage team members to deliver consistently across multiple Paid Search and Paid Social campaigns.</li> <li>Act as a key biddable point-of-contact for clients, maintaining their confidence in the team's output.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence &amp; Innovation:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee operational excellence, including financial accuracy, data integrity, and end-to-end campaign management processes across Biddable channels.</li> <li>Act as an escalation point for activation issues, troubleshooting, and resolving conflicts between best practice and client requirements.</li> <li>Drive innovation by building annual learning agendas and comprehensive test plans for assigned portfolios, fostering continuous optimization.</li> <li>Contribute to agency-wide continuous improvement projects regarding processes and quality standards.</li> <li>Lead through vision, values, and model leadership behaviours while championing and facilitating change.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate strong commercial acumen, leading on the delivery of services in line with client objectives, service level agreements, and terms of business.</li> <li>Develop ways of working that maximise client output whilst minimizing operational input.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Deep Biddable Expertise:</strong>&nbsp;Extensive experience (e.g., 7+ years) in digital media, with specialization across both Paid Search (Google Ads, Bing Ads) and Paid Social (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok, Pinterest, etc.). Proven track record of driving performance for clients across biddable channels.</li> <li><strong>Platform Proficiency:</strong>&nbsp;Experience with planning and directly managing large-scale Paid Search (PPC) and Paid Social campaigns. title: Staff Data Engineer - GTM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What is the opportunity?</h2> <p>Every go-to-market decision at Intercom, who we target, who owns the account, what we know about them, what we should say next - rests on a foundation of account and contact data. Getting that foundation right is one of the highest-leverage engineering problems in the company: a single account hierarchy fix can re-route territory, pipeline credit and forecast for thousands of accounts at once.</p> <p>This role owns that foundation. You will build and run the systems that decide what an account <em>is</em>, resolving duplicates, stitching subsidiaries into corporate hierarchies, sourcing new accounts and contacts into our CRM, and enriching them with firmographic, technographic and intent signals. Increasingly using LLMs and web research rather than off-the-shelf vendors. Your work is used daily by Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Sales Ops and Finance, and directly shapes how efficiently Intercom grows.</p> <p>You will sit in the Data group and partner extremely closely with GTM Systems, RevOps and the frontline teams. This is a role for an engineer who wants to be <em>in</em> the business, not adjacent to it. Someone who gets energy from a rep saying "this list is exactly right" and from watching a pipeline they built turn into revenue.</p> <h2>What will I be doing?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Owning account identity.</strong> Building and improving the entity-resolution layer that decides when two records are the same company: domain and firmographic matching, confidence scoring, and the merge/dedupe pipelines that keep Salesforce clean at scale.</li> <li><strong>Modelling account hierarchy.</strong> Designing the organisation spine that links accounts to their parent, top operating parent and ultimate corporate parent.</li> <li><strong>Building account sourcing pipelines.</strong> Turning market definitions into ranked, deduplicated, CRM-ready account lists: sourcing from third-party and internal signals, scoring fit, and pushing accounts into Salesforce with the right owner and the right metadata.</li> <li><strong>Building contact sourcing and enrichment pipelines.</strong> Finding the right people at target accounts, verifying and enriching them, respecting privacy and consent requirements, and delivering them into the tools reps and marketers actually work in.</li> <li><strong>Building LLM-powered enrichment.</strong> Extending our enrichment framework — LLM jobs with web search and crawling tools across multiple providers, to answer questions no vendor sells: what support channels does this company run, are they hiring CS or sales roles, do they ship an AI product, how ready are they for Fin.</li> <li><strong>Making the data usable.</strong> Landing everything in well-modelled, well-tested dbt models in Snowflake orchestrated in Airflow, and syncing it out to Salesforce, Marketo, Clay and the rest of the GTM stack.</li> <li><strong>Owning quality and trust.</strong> Instrumenting your pipelines with tests, alerts and reconciliation so problems surface before a rep finds them, and being the person GTM comes to when a number looks wrong.</li> <li><strong>Partnering on the problem, not the ticket.</strong> Sitting with Sales, Marketing and Ops to understand what they are actually trying to do, then proposing the data foundation that unlocks it.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>A genuine interest in growing the business and a real affinity for GTM teams.</strong> You are curious about how sales and marketing work, comfortable in a room full of reps, and motivated by commercial outcomes rather than only technical ones.</li> <li>Experience with the modern data stack: dbt, a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake), and a DAG orchestrator (we use Airflow).</li> <li>Experience building with LLMs in production: prompt design and evaluation, tool/function calling, web search and crawling, cost and latency control.</li> <li>Experience with entity resolution, identity or deduplication problems — matching messy real-world records, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs where a false merge has a real business cost.</li> <li>Hands-on experience integrating with SaaS APIs and business systems, especially Salesforce: reading from them, writing back to them.</li> <li>Strong communication: you can explain a hierarchy change to a CRO and a merge heuristic to an engineer, on the same day.</li> <li>A growth mindset and eagerness to learn — the tooling in this space is changing fast.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with GTM data vendors and tooling — ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, Clay, Crossbeam, Marketo, Census/Fivetran, Gong.</li> <li>Experience with territory design, account scoring, propensity models or ICP definition.</li> <li>Exposure to privacy and compliance considerations around contact data (GDPR, CCPA, consent management).</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. raw.description:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

About the role

We’re growing fast! We’re a team of around 200 in 4 locations, and we’re looking for someone to help keep our people processes running smoothly as we scale.

You’ll be the go-to person for employee questions and the engine behind our day-to-day People ops, from onboarding and contracts to HRIS data and compliance. You won’t just be running processes, you’ll be building them too, so there’s real ownership and lots of room to make things better. It’s a broad, hands-on role, and it’s perfect for you if you’re organised, curious, and love making things work seamlessly behind the scenes.

What you’ll be doing

  • Admin: Looking after onboarding, offboarding, contracts and changes, probation, and leave and absence across all countries

  • Compliance: Overseeing background screening, and keeping our policies up to date as employment laws change

  • HRIS and data: Keeping HiBob accurate and tidy, and building workflows that cut down on manual admin

  • Payroll: Coordinating compensation and payroll-related administration with the Finance team, including employee query resolution

  • Benefits: Managing enrolment, changes, and employee queries across benefits programmes

  • Employee support: Being the first point of contact for questions on policies, processes, benefits and systems, and knowing when to sort things yourself and when to escalate

  • Self-serve and AI: Helping us build our People knowledge base in Confluence from the ground up so everyone can find answers fast, and exploring smart ways to use AI and automation to take the busywork out of People ops

  • Projects: Getting stuck into People initiatives as we grow, from performance and engagement cycles in Culture Amp to policy rollouts and process improvements

What you’ll need

  • 2–4 years in People Ops, HR Ops or an HR Generalist role, ideally in fintech or somewhere fast-growing

  • Good working knowledge of UK employment law

  • Hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle

  • Some exposure to employee relations, such as supporting cases, taking notes or tracking issues through to resolution

  • Experience with a multi-country team, or the ability to pick up local nuances quickly and work across time zones

  • Experience using an HRIS (bonus points for HiBob), and you’re comfortable with Excel

  • A real eye for detail and the organisation to juggle lots of requests without dropping the ball

  • Discretion and good judgement with confidential info and sensitive situations

  • Clear, friendly communication with everyone from new joiners to senior leaders

  • A helpful, reliable approach, and a habit of always looking for a better way to do things

  • Comfort with pace and a bit of ambiguity, because lots of our processes are still being built

What we offer

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

  • Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career.  As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.   Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect. IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group. As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout. The role The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process. You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy. What you'll bring to the role We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include: Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital. You should be confident working within an Agile framework, with an understanding of secure development practices and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and access management. An international mindset, sensitivity to local business priorities, and a collaborative approach are essential. What’s in it for you?   At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:  A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation  Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond  Ongoing learning and development supported by tailored programmes and resources  A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, innovation, and continuous improvement  Flexible working with a remote first working policy Benefits   Healthcare Cash Plan  Cycle to Work scheme  Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme  Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you  Discounted staff pet care   Access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers    Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging   At IVC Evidensia we are committed to Diversity, Equality, Inclusion and Belonging, we are keen to hear from candidates from all minority and diverse groups. IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout.

The role

The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process.

You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy.

What you'll bring to the role

We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include:

  • Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles
  • PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing
  • Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps
  • Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role
  • ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols
  • Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles

Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital.

Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design

  • Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets

  • Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets

raw.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Support team as the direct manager of a group of Support Engineers. While the function operates globally, with part of the team in Paris and the rest in New York, this specific role is based in Paris.

You will report to Matthieu, Global Head of Scale CS, and your manager, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also partner closely with Support Operations, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, and IT. You will also be part of the global Go-To-Market community across our international offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As Support Team Lead, you will be the direct manager of our Support Engineers and accountable for the team's day-to-day performance, development, and service delivery. You will translate our Support strategy into effective routines, consistent execution, and an excellent customer experience.

This is a player-coach role. Your primary focus is managing and developing the team, but you'll stay close to operations, supporting complex investigations, reviewing ticket quality, and coordinating escalations when needed. The Head of Support defines the strategy and long-term evolution of the function. You make sure the team delivers on it every day.

We're looking for someone who is a natural people developer: accountable, structured, thorough, calm under pressure, data-informed, proactive, and collaborative. We strongly believe in growing our people internally, and this role is also a strong stepping stone toward broader Support and Customer Success leadership for those who want to keep growing.

People Management & Team Development

Directly manage, coach, and develop the Support Engineers to help them perform at their best and grow in their careers:

  • Hold regular one-to-ones, set clear expectations, and provide frequent, actionable feedback

  • Monitor individual performance, address issues when needed, and lead performance reviews and development plans

  • Identify skills gaps and organize coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing

  • Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, and participate in hiring

  • Foster a culture of customer empathy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Daily Service Delivery & Escalation Management

Own the daily delivery of Support and act as the first point of management escalation for complex, urgent, or sensitive cases:

  • Monitor ticket queues, backlog, workload, and service levels, and ensure tickets are correctly prioritized and followed through

  • Organize team coverage (absences, shifts, peak periods) and step in when service delivery is at risk

  • Review and coordinate escalated tickets, defining next steps and involving the right internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success)

  • Coordinate customer communication on significant cases, and escalate major risks or executive concerns to the Head of Support

Quality, Process, & Performance

Maintain high standards of technical quality, and bring a critical, structured eye to how Support operates today, proposing and driving changes rather than simply preserving the status quo:

  • Identify where tickets could be resolved faster and more efficiently in writing, and reduce the number of cases that unnecessarily escalate into calls, especially multi-stakeholder ones, to protect everyone's time and improve the ROI of customer interactions

  • Review ticket quality using QA tools and scorecards, and coach the team based on the results

  • Ensure investigations are structured, well-documented, and clearly communicated to customers

  • Monitor operational and quality indicators (backlog, response/resolution time, CSAT, quality scores) to identify risks and drive corrective action

  • Document, monitor adoption of, and continuously improve Support workflows, in partnership with Support Operations

Cross-functional Collaboration

Make sure Support works effectively with the rest of the business.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on customer investigations and product issues

  • Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales on customer situations requiring Support involvement, and continuously refine which team owns which type of request across the client lifecycle

  • Clarify responsibilities and handovers between Support and other teams, and represent the team's operational needs in cross-functional discussions

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Zendesk (or an equivalent ticketing platform), our data stack tools, Microsoft Office, UpSlide, and internal knowledge-base tools (or local equivalents).

⚡Your goals

You will be assessed on:

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

  • Time to Resolution (TTR)

  • Ticket-to-active-user ratio

  • Team engagement and development


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Proven experience managing or leading a customer-facing team, ideally in B2B SaaS, technical support, or a similar operational environment

  • Strong coaching and people-development skills, including the ability to give clear, constructive, and sometimes difficult feedback

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across a team

  • Experience using service or operational metrics to identify issues and improve performance

  • Strong customer communication and escalation-management skills

  • Ability to understand technical issues and guide structured investigations, without needing to personally own every ticket

  • Fluent in French & English mandatory

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams

  • A pragmatic, accountable approach to problem-solving, with a bias for ownership over escalation

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience directly managing a team of five or more people

  • Experience supporting Enterprise customers

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Office add-ins, deployment, or IT environments

  • Familiarity with Zendesk or a similar ticketing platform

  • Experience with quality and knowledge management, or Support Operations

  • Experience supporting distributed or international teams

  • Familiarity with automation, AI-assisted Support, or self-service strategies

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your management experience in Support.

  3. Case study and a team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  4. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: 2-3 days in-office per week

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. raw.title: Planning and Supply Chain Manager
raw.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

At Quandela, we're moving from an R&D-driven organization toward a structured, scalable industrial operation. We're looking for a builder as much as a manager to create our end-to-end supply chain, from demand to customer delivery. Your first major challenge: build our S&OP process from the ground up. You'll move easily between strategy and execution, from running an S&OP review and an 18-month capacity outlook to solving a critical component shortage or securing an urgent customer shipment. 

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Build the S&OP process from scratch: define governance, meeting cadence, roles, inputs and KPIs, then progressively mature it as the company scales 
  • Lead monthly cross-functional S&OP reviews with Sales, Operations, Production, R&D, Purchasing, Finance and Management, and establish a single shared view of demand, supply and customer commitments
  • Consolidate demand from customer orders, weighted commercial forecasts, internal R&D needs, qualification activities and strategic programs into a rolling forecast
  • Build and maintain the Master Production Schedule, with planning horizons adapted to our long manufacturing and supply lead times
  • Translate demand into capacity, resource, material and supplier requirements, identify gaps and develop scenarios to support management decisions on priorities and commitments
  • Turn the production plan into executable schedules, monitor WIP and progress, and coordinate recovery plans when delays or shortages occur
  • Structure purchasing and MRP processes, define sourcing strategies based on lead time, criticality, supply risk, cost and MOQ, and track supplier performance (OTD, quality, responsiveness)
  • Define inventory principles and safety-stock strategies for critical components, while managing excess, obsolete and slow-moving stock
  • Organize inbound, internal and outbound logistics, including the transport of fragile, sensitive and high-value technological products
  • Manage customs and international trade: import/export documentation, classification, country of origin, Incoterms and compliance, in coordination with forwarders and brokers
  • Contribute to the selection and deployment of ERP/MRP and planning tools, reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and build clear supply chain dashboards
  • Define and track key KPIs (forecast accuracy, plan adherence, supplier and customer OTD/OTIF, inventory turns, shortages, lead times) and drive continuous improvement

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Engineering or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in planning, supply chain or industrial operations
  • Proven experience implementing or running an S&OP process 
  • APICS / ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP)
  • Strong command of demand and production planning, scheduling, MRP, purchasing, inventory management and logistics 
  • Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to turn complex data into clear priorities and decisions
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills
  • Thrives in a fast-changing, growing organization
  • Fluent French and English 

 Nice to have

Proposer et piloter les actions correctives permettant d'améliorer la disponibilité des pièces, le niveau de service et la maîtrise des stocks. Assurer un reporting régulier auprès du management. Piloter les projets stratégiques Supply Chain Conduire ou contribuer aux projets structurants liés aux processus, aux outils, à la gestion des stocks et à l'organisation logistique. Some travel to our offices will be required from time-to-time</p> <p>You must have the right to work in one the above countries in order to be considered for the role.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>💼 About the role</strong></p> <p>PQShield is looking for a Product Marketing Director who can turn complex technology into stories that people understand, remember, and act on.</p> <p>You will own how PQShield's products, technology, and vision are positioned, communicated, and brought to market worldwide. You'll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, sales, customers, and the broader security market — translating breakthrough cryptography and security technology into compelling narratives for executives, engineers, partners, and buyers.</p> <p>This role is for a strategic product marketer and exceptional storyteller who can identify the market shift, understand the customer problem, and turn complex technology into differentiated positioning that creates urgency, preference and demand.&nbsp;</p> <p>Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, organizations across semiconductors, automotive, defense, and enterprise face significant challenges in preparing for the post-quantum transition. This role will help define the market narrative around that transition, position PQShield's portfolio within it and give customers a clear reason to act.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>⚒️ What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the story: Develop the narrative, positioning, messaging, and value propositions that explain what is changing in the market, why customers need to act, the problem PQShield solves, and why our approach is differentiated.</li> <li>Turn technical capability into customer value: Work with cryptographers, engineers and product leaders to understand sophisticated technology, identify what matters to the buyer and translate technical capabilities into clear business and security value without sacrificing technical credibility.</li> <li>Position the portfolio: Own positioning and messaging for our hardware IP and software portfolio, including PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib. Build a clear messaging architecture that connects the portfolio while preserving the differentiated value of each offering.</li> <li>Understand the customer: Develop deep insight into customer problems, buying journeys, security requirements, regulatory pressures, barriers to adoption, buying dynamics, and the forces driving post-quantum adoption. Turn those insights into sharper products, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.</li> <li>Shape category and market narrative: Help define how PQShield talks about post-quantum security, cryptographic agility, and the transition to quantum-safe systems — and how we differentiate our approach in a rapidly evolving market.</li> <li>Lead product launches: Create and execute compelling go-to-market strategies for new products, certifications, partnerships, and major releases.</li> <li>Equip the sales team: Build compelling presentations, stories, solution briefs, case studies, battlecards, and other tools that help sales teams communicate value and win complex deals.</li> <li>Build buyer and segment-specific stories: Develop differentiated narratives for semiconductors, automotive, military and aerospace, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise, adapting the value story for different buyers, use cases and business priorities.</li> <li>Own competitive storytelling: Understand the competitive landscape and turn technical and commercial differences into clear, credible differentiation.</li> <li>Create exceptional content: Lead the development of white papers, thought leadership, application notes, customer stories, executive content, web experiences, and other material that establishes PQShield as a category leader.</li> <li>Bring customer stories to life: Find and develop the stories that demonstrate why customers are making the transition to post-quantum security and why they choose PQShield.</li> <li>Work across the company: Partner closely with product, engineering, sales, partnerships, and leadership to ensure the market sees one clear, compelling PQShield story.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications</strong></p> <p>We're looking for an experienced product marketing leader who is exceptionally strong in positioning, messaging and strategic storytelling. You can take something highly technical and make it understandable, interesting, and compelling without dumbing it down.</li> <li>Strong storytelling instincts and the ability to find the human, business, and strategic narrative inside complex technology.</li> <li>Experience marketing technical B2B products, ideally in cybersecurity, semiconductors, infrastructure, embedded systems, software, or another sophisticated technology market.</li> <li>Strong understanding of security and technology buyers, and the ability to communicate credibly with CISOs, CTOs, engineers, architects, product leaders, and business executives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work closely with technical experts and quickly develop enough subject-matter expertise to challenge assumptions, ask good questions, and tell an accurate story.</li> <li>A strong commercial mindset: you understand that great marketing isn't just about explaining a product — it's about creating differentiation, urgency, preference, and ultimately revenue.</li> <li>Experience launching products and taking complex offerings to market.</li> <li>Experience developing compelling sales narratives and enablement for complex, multi-stakeholder sales.</li> <li>Excellent strategic judgment, with the ability to determine what the market needs to hear, why it matters, and how PQShield should say it.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where you will often need to create the narrative before the market has established one.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What we can offer you</strong></p> <ul> <li>A competitive compensation package.</li> <li>Share options.</li> <li>A remote first company. We're looking for a QA Engineer to join White Circle, an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems through natural-language policies it automatically tests, enforces, and improves at scale. Backed by $70M (Series A) from top funds and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, and others, White Circle processes 100M+ API calls monthly and trains its own LLMs. This is a manual-first product QA role, with automation as a key tool, in a small team where work ships to production fast.

You will

  • Manually test new features and fixes across the web platform and APIs in fast release cycles, sometimes as short as one working day.

  • Identify the highest-risk areas, run exploratory, smoke, regression, and integration testing, and give clear release feedback.

  • Write concise test plans and checklists, investigate unexpected behavior, and file reproducible bug reports.

  • Work with engineers and product owners to clarify requirements and improve testability before development is complete.

  • Automate stable, business-critical flows with Playwright and Python, and integrate them into CI/CD.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in QA automation, including building frameworks from scratch.

  • Strong Playwright experience for E2E UI testing and scalable test suite design.

  • Clean Python automation code (pytest, fixtures, parametrize).

  • Hands-on CI/CD integration (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).

  • Practical use of AI coding agents and LLM-powered developer tools in testing workflows.

  • Fluent English and clear communication.

  • Based in or relocating to Paris or London (hybrid).

Bonus

  • Testing AI/LLM products: non-deterministic outputs, confidence scoring, edge-case prompts.

  • Performance or load testing (k6, Locust).

  • API testing tools (Postman, Insomnia, Yaak) or contract testing.

  • Security-aware QA or SOC 2 environments.

We offer

  • Competitive salary + equity.

  • Hybrid work from Paris or London, relocation package for Paris.

  • Top-tier medical insurance in France and flexible time off.

  • L&D budget, all hardware and tools you need, plus covered AI agent and IDE subscriptions.

  • Team off-sites twice a year.

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1,250,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Why this role matters at Pennylane

Within our “track-based” organization, the Core Accounting team sits at the heart of our product value proposition: reliability, efficiency, and automation of day-to-day accounting operations. Working directly with the Head of Product for the track, the Senior Strategy & Operations role brings the structure, cadence, and operational standards needed to turn priorities into clear, measurable, and scalable execution within a context of growing complexity (multiple stakeholders, fast trade-offs, monetization topics).

Your responsibilities

Strategic planning and execution

  • Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives

  • Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth

Data-driven decision making

  • Lead comprehensive analyses to identify market opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and growth levers

  • Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative research

Project leadership

  • Spearhead strategic initiatives and pilot programs from ideation through implementation and measurement

  • Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

Cross-functional orchestration

  • Serve as the operational nexus between the track and horizontal teams including care, sales, and the other product teams.

  • Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries

Performance management

  • Own the OKR process for the track, ensuring clarity of objectives and accountability for results

  • Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics

  • Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them

Who we’re looking for

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments

  • Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact

  • Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently

Core competencies

  • Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals

  • Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes

  • Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation

  • Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders

  • Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup.

You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role.

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Laura - Head of Product Core Accounting (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos.
